parts.label: Part 1
parts.name: Listening — Choose the best reply
parts.rubric: Questions 1 – 6. You will hear six short sentences. For each one, choose the best reply. You will hear each sentence twice.

opts: Yes, there are – in this street.

parts.label: Part 2
parts.name: Vocabulary — Hotels
parts.rubric: Questions 7 – 12. Choose the word to match the picture. Write the correct letter, A – G.

parts.label: Part 3
parts.name: Vocabulary — Places in a town
parts.rubric: Questions 13 – 18. Look at the pictures of places. What are the missing letters? Some letters are already there. There is one space for each other letter in the word. Gõ trọn vẹn từ vào ô trả lời.

parts.label: Part 4
parts.name: Reading — Diana’s Town
parts.rubric: Questions 19 – 24. Read the text about Diana and her town. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each space.

passage.title: Diana’s Town
passage.html: My name is Diana. I live in Grandford with my family. Grandford is a small town in England. (19) …… lots of beautiful old houses in Grandford. (20) …… a lovely hotel – I work there – and lots of good shops and cafés too. (21) …… a big swimming pool in Grandford and some very good schools but (22) …… a university. I like my town. Where do you live? (23) …… a university in your town? (24) …… any swimming pools in your town?

parts.label: Part 5
parts.name: Grammar — there is / there are
parts.rubric: Questions 25 – 30. Read the sentences about a city. Choose the best answer, A, B or C, for each space.

qs.text: There a nice restaurant in the city.
are three good hotels in the city.
There two banks on Main Street.
a swimming pool near the hotel?
many car parks in the centre of the city.
any good restaurants on Main Street?
